entities.summary: freeglut is an open-source alternative to the OpenGL Utility Toolkit (GLUT) library. GLUT enables the user to create and manage windows containing OpenGL contexts on a wide range of platforms and also read the mouse, keyboard and joystick functions. freeglut is intended to be a full replacement for GLUT, and has only a few differences.
